tools.name: post_flights_bookings
tools.description:
## Overview

Complete a flight reservation by confirming a prebook and processing payment. This is the final step in the booking flow.

## When to Use

- **Final booking confirmation** - Convert a prebook into a confirmed booking
- **Payment completion** - Confirm with Stripe (`TRANSACTION_ID`), bill an enabled **credit line** (`CREDIT`), pay with a **credit card** (`CREDIT_CARD` via the secure endpoint), or charge the **card stored on your account** (`ACC_CREDIT_CARD`)
- **After service selection** - Book after optionally attaching seats or baggage via the services endpoint

## What You Get

- **Confirmed booking** with a unique booking ID
- **Payment confirmation** with transaction details
- **Full itinerary** including all segments and passenger assignments
- **Provider confirmation** reference number

## Key Features

- **Idempotent**: Returns the existing booking (HTTP 200 + `data[0].message`) if one already exists for the given `prebookId`. Transient book failures are retried in place without exposing a terminal failure status. Concurrent duplicate requests while a book is in progress return HTTP 409 (`45035`).
- **Payments**: Stripe uses `transactionId` from prebook or attach-services after SDK confirmation; credit line uses `CREDIT` with server-side eligibility checks; `CREDIT_CARD` charges the provided card immediately — send card details in `billingInfo` via `https://pci-book.liteapi.travel` (contact the team to enable this on your API key); `ACC_CREDIT_CARD` charges the card saved on your account immediately, with no card details in the request (in sandbox it simulates the booking without a charge)
- **Provider confirmation**: Finalizes the reservation on the provider side

## Quick Start

**Required fields**: `prebookId` (from `POST /flights/prebooks`), `payment` with `method` and, for Stripe, `transactionId`

**Tip**: If you used `POST /flights/prebooks/{prebookId}/services` to attach ancillary services, use the new `transactionId` from that response, not the original prebook `transactionId`.

prebookId.description: The prebookId returned by `POST /flights/prebooks` (prebook must have completed the book step).

transactionId.description: Stripe payment intent transaction id when using `TRANSACTION_ID`. Omit when using `CREDIT`, `THIRD_PARTY`, `CREDIT_CARD`, or `ACC_CREDIT_CARD`.

token.description: RSA-signed JWT from the whitelabel payment gateway when `method` is `THIRD_PARTY`. Required for CMI/WL checkout. The token must reference the same prebook and include the gateway transaction id.

holderName.description: Cardholder name. Defaults to the first passenger's name if omitted.

billingInfo.description: Card details for the payment. Required when `method` is `CREDIT_CARD`. Accepts any credit or debit card, including virtual credit cards. Send card details via the secure payment endpoint (`https://pci-book.liteapi.travel`); card number and security code are tokenized before reaching LiteAPI.

payment.description: Payment for `POST /flights/bookings`: Stripe (`TRANSACTION_ID` + `transactionId`), credit line (`CREDIT`), whitelabel/CMI (`THIRD_PARTY` + `token`), direct card via the secure endpoint (`CREDIT_CARD` + `billingInfo`), or the card stored on your account (`ACC_CREDIT_CARD`).

customTags.description: Optional bag of up to 5 user-defined key/value labels persisted with the booking. Keys must match `^[A-Z0-9_-]+$` (uppercase letters, digits, `-`, `_`). Values are arbitrary strings up to 255 characters.

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the requester (or derived).

country.description: The country inferred from the requester's IP, aiding in regional compliance.

language.description: The preferred language from the user's browser settings.

platform.description: The operating system or device platform from which the request originates.

device_id.description: A unique identifier for the user's device, useful for tracking and security.

user_agent.description: The browser/OS user agent string for verifying request authenticity.

utm_medium.description: The marketing medium (e.g., email, ad) through which the service was accessed.

utm_source.description: The source of the traffic, such as a search engine or social network.

utm_campaign.description: An identifier for the specific marketing campaign that led to the request.

metadata.description: Optional. Encapsulates essential booking metadata, including IP, location, language, device details, and marketing parameters.

tools.name: post_flights_prebooks
tools.description:
## Overview

Initiate a flight booking session by reserving the offer with the provider, creating a payment intent when you use the Stripe SDK, and discovering available ancillary services — all in a single request.

## When to Use

- **Start the booking flow** once a user has confirmed their flight selection
- **Collect passenger details** and initiate payment processing
- **Discover add-ons** like seat selection and extra baggage before final confirmation

## What You Get

- **Prebook ID** required to complete the booking at `/flights/bookings`
- **Payment intent** (`transactionId`, `secretKey`) when `usePaymentSdk` is true — for Stripe SDK integration
- **Credit line snapshot** (`creditLine` in the response) when you set `includeCreditBalance: true` and your account has an enabled credit line with payment bypass
- **Available services** (`servicesAttachable`) including seats and baggage options
- **Booking confirmation** from the provider with reservation details

## Key Features

- **End-to-end prebook flow**: Verifies offer → payment setup (Stripe payment intent or credit line) → books with provider → fetches services
- **Payment options**: `usePaymentSdk: true` uses the Stripe SDK. `usePaymentSdk: false` is allowed when your user has **payment bypass** (sandbox or whitelabel) and either an **enabled credit line** or a **whitelabel/CMI** checkout (no Stripe intent; complete payment via WL and call `/flights/bookings` with `payment.method: THIRD_PARTY` and `payment.token`)
- **Ancillary services**: Returns attachable services (seats, baggage) that can be added before final booking
- **Same shape as /book**: Uses `offerId` instead of `prebookId`

## Quick Start

**Required fields**: `offerId` (from search/verify), `contact` (name, email, `phoneCountryCode`, phone), `passengers` (with `passengerType`, birthday, gender, nationality, document, and name details).

**Payment**: Send `usePaymentSdk: true` for Stripe (typical). Send `usePaymentSdk: false` when paying on credit line or via whitelabel/CMI (requires payment bypass); otherwise you receive a validation error.

**Tip**: Use the `servicesAttachable` in the response to offer seat selection or extra baggage before calling `/flights/bookings`.

offerId.description: The offerId from the search results (msgpack-encoded; unpacks to provider offerId)

usePaymentSdk.description: If true, a Stripe payment intent is created (`transactionId`, `secretKey`). If false, payment bypass must apply and the account must use credit line or whitelabel/CMI checkout (no Stripe intent); otherwise the request is rejected.

includeCreditBalance.description: Optional flag to include credit line information in the response. When set to true, credit line details will be returned if the user has a credit line available.

descriptorSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the Stripe payment descriptor (visible on customer's bank statement)

paymentMethodConfiguration.description: Stripe Payment Method Configuration ID (pmc_...) controlling which payment methods Payment Element presents for this PaymentIntent.

voucherCode.description: An optional voucher code to apply discounts to the booking. The vouchers API allows creation of these discounts

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the traveler (or derived).

country.description: The country inferred from the traveler's IP, aiding in regional compliance.

language.description: The preferred language from the user's browser settings.

platform.description: The operating system or device platform from which the request originates.

device_id.description: A unique identifier for the user's device, useful for tracking and security.

user_agent.description: The browser/OS user agent string for verifying request authenticity.

utm_medium.description: The marketing medium (e.g., email, ad) through which the service was accessed.

utm_source.description: The source of the traffic, such as a search engine or social network.

utm_campaign.description: An identifier for the specific marketing campaign that led to the request.

metadata.description: Optional. Traveler metadata (IP, device, language, marketing parameters), same shape as `POST /flights/bookings` `metadata`. It is stored with the prebook and attached to the Stripe payment intent so the traveler's IP / device (rather than your backend's) is visible for fraud review. When omitted, the request IP and User-Agent are used.

email.description: Contact email address for booking confirmation

phoneCountryCode.description: Phone country calling code without + (e.g. 1 for US, 33 for France). Required by the flights provider.

contact.description: Primary contact person for the booking (receives confirmation emails)

documentIssueCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the document issuing country (optional)

firstName.description: Passenger first name (as on travel document)

gender.description: Passenger gender: M, F, or X

lastName.description: Passenger last name (as on travel document)

nationality.description: Passenger nationality as ISO country code

airlineCode.description: IATA airline code of the loyalty program (e.g. AA, BA, LH)

loyaltyPrograms.description: Frequent flyer / loyalty programs for this passenger (Sabre and Travelport only; ignored for Atlas).

passengers.description: List of passengers travelling. Length must match the adults+children+infants counts from the search.

tools.name: confirmFlightTicketedServices
tools.description:
## Overview

Sells the selection `batchId` on the ticketed reservation and settles its payment. Runs synchronously.

## Outcomes

- **200 `sold` / `partially_sold`** - the payment is captured (credit line billed) for what was sold; the unsold part is released. `booking.pricing` and `booking.ticketedServices` include the sale.
- **202 `requested`** - the provider did not answer: the sale may have happened. The payment stays authorized until the reservation confirms or drops the services (webhook or a later `GET /flights/bookings/{bookingId}`). Do not select the services again.
- **409 `44115`** - a service is no longer offered at the price shown: nothing was sold, the payment was released. Select again.
- **502 `54105`** - the airline rejected the services: nothing was sold, the payment was released.

## Retrying

The call is idempotent on `batchId`: a retry returns the first result (`X-Idempotent-Replayed: true`) and never sells or charges twice.

## Partner events

`flight.book.services_sold` / `flight.book.services_failed` fire once per sale.

## Access

Same as `POST /flights/bookings/{bookingId}/services`: account option, or system admin / operations on any account's booking.

tools.name: searchExperienceTours
tools.description:
## Overview

Search available tours and activities with localized content and prices in your chosen currency. Supports free-text or geo search, plus filtering by date, language, price, category, rating, duration, and tour flags.

## When to Use

- **Search results** - Populate a tours listing or map view
- **Destination pages** - Show activities available in a city or region
- **Category browsing** - Filter tours by type, duration, or rating

## What You Get

- **Tour listings** - Titles, descriptions, images, and ratings
- **Localized content** - Names and descriptions in the requested language
- **Prices** - Amounts in the requested currency

## Quick Start

**Required:** `language`, `currency`

**Search (pick one):** `textSearch`, or `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`/`location[radiusKm]`

**Filters:** `dateRange[from]`/`dateRange[to]`, `languages`, `price[min]`/`price[max]`, `categories`, `rating[min]`/`rating[max]`, `duration[min]`/`duration[max]`, `flags`

**Sort:** `sort[field]`/`sort[direction]`

**Pagination:** `pagination[limit]`/`pagination[offset]`

Returns a paginated list of matching tours.

textSearch.description: Free-text search term (location name, tour title, etc). Mutually exclusive with `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`.

location[latitude].description: Geo filter latitude. Must be sent together with `location[longitude]` and `location[radiusKm]`. Mutually exclusive with `textSearch`.

location[longitude].description: Geo filter longitude. Must be sent together with `location[latitude]` and `location[radiusKm]`.

location[radiusKm].description: Geo filter radius in kilometers around `location[latitude]`/`location[longitude]`.

dateRange[from].description: Only return tours offered on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

dateRange[to].description: Only return tours offered on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

languages.description: Filter to tours conducted in one or more of these ISO language codes (repeat the param per value, e.g. `languages=en&languages=fr`). Distinct from the required `language` param, which only controls localized content on the response.

price[min].description: Minimum partner-facing selling price, in the requested `currency`. Bounds are interpreted using the same cent rounding as the returned price.

price[max].description: Maximum partner-facing selling price, in the requested `currency`. Bounds are interpreted using the same cent rounding as the returned price.

categories.description: Filter to one or more category ids (repeat the param per value, e.g. `categories=1&categories=2`). See the category `id`/`name` pairs returned on each tour.

flags.description: Filter to tours matching one or more of these properties (repeat the param per value, e.g. `flags=wheelchair&flags=pick-up`).

sort[field].description: Field to sort results by. `popularity` returns an internal recommended ranking and ignores `sort[direction]`.

pagination[limit].description: Maximum number of tours to return.

pagination[offset].description: Number of tours to skip, for pagination.

tools.description:
## Overview

Resolve priced booking options, time slots, and required guest inputs for a selected tour date and participant mix.

## When to Use

- **Live pricing** - Display slot totals (`pricing.totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`)

## What You Get

- **Time slots** - `dateTime`, `isAvailable`, and slot-level pricing (`unitNet` / `totalNet` / `totals.net` / `priceSummary.netPrice`, plus `totals.commission`)
- **Participant mapping** - Uses `ticketCategory` keys from availability (e.g. `adult`, `child`)

## Quick Start

POST a body with `language`, `currency`, `date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`), and `participants` to `/experiences/tours/{id}/booking-options`. Use slot `pricing.totals.net` as `selection.price.amount` on prebook, and for checkout handoff.

## Option-level `price`

`options[].price.amount` reflects the lowest available slot price for the requested mix. Checkout uses the chosen slot's `pricing.totals.net`.

language.description: ISO language code for localized content.

participants.description: Participant counts keyed by ticket category (age band), e.g. `adult`, `child`. Keys are lowercase and must match a `ticketCategory` returned by `GET /experiences/tours/{id}/availability` for this tour. An array (e.g. `[{"category":"adult","count":2}]`) is rejected, and uppercase keys (e.g. `ADULT`) are rejected - use the exact lowercase category strings from availability.

addons.description: Optional add-ons to price alongside the tour, from `GET .../availability` `addons[].id`.

## Overview

Confirm the booking after the guest completes payment, using the `prebookId` and `transactionId` from the prebook step.

## When to Use

- **Final booking step** - After the guest confirms payment via the Stripe SDK using the prebook's `secretKey`

## What You Get

- **`status`** - `PENDING_CONFIRMATION` right away; final `CONFIRMED` status arrives via webhook
- **`price`** / **`commission`** / **`clientCommission`** - Your price and earnings for this booking

## Quick Start

POST with `prebookId`, `billing`, `traveler`, and `payment.method: TRANSACTION_ID`. An `ERROR` status on the underlying cart returns HTTP 502.

customTags.description: Optional bag of up to 5 user-defined key/value labels persisted with the booking. Keys must match `^[A-Z0-9_-]+$`; values are strings up to 255 characters.

## Overview

Retrieve the current state of an experience booking by its booking ID, including status, pricing, and voucher details once available.

## When to Use

- **Poll for confirmation** - Check whether a booking has moved from `PENDING_CONFIRMATION` to `CONFIRMED`
- **Booking details page** - Display status, price, and voucher to the guest
- **Support queries** - Look up a booking's current state

## What You Get

- **`status`** - Current booking status (`PENDING_CONFIRMATION`, `CONFIRMED`, `FAILED`, `CANCELLED`)
- **`voucher`** - Ticket/reference details, once available
- **`price`** / **`commission`** / **`clientCommission`** - Your price and earnings for this booking
- **Cancellation details** - `refund`, `cancellationRequestedAt`, `cancelledAt`, `refundProcessedAt`, when applicable

## Quick Start

GET with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. Poll until `status` is `CONFIRMED` (or use webhooks), or retrieve the voucher once available.

## Overview

Preview the refund amount and cancellation fee for a booking before committing to cancel it.

## When to Use

- **Cancellation confirmation screens** - Show the guest exactly what they'll be refunded
- **Support tooling** - Check whether a booking is still cancellable before offering a refund

## What You Get

- **`cancellable`** - Whether the booking can currently be cancelled
- **`policy`** - `cancellationFee`, `refundAmount`, `refundType`, `estimateConfidence`, `currency`, `sellingPrice`

## Quick Start

GET this endpoint with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. This does not cancel the booking - call `POST /experiences/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel` to actually cancel.

## Overview

Cancel a confirmed experience booking and trigger any applicable refund.

## When to Use

- **Guest-initiated cancellation** - After the guest confirms via the cancel-preview screen

## What You Get

- **`status`** - Booking status after cancellation
- **`providerStatus`** - Raw upstream provider status, when available
- **`refund`** - Present when a refund was calculated; `refundPending` indicates it hasn't settled yet

## Quick Start

POST with the `bookingId` from `POST /experiences/bookings`. Call `GET /experiences/bookings/{bookingId}/cancel-preview` first to show the guest the refund amount.
